Check Completeness of a Date Sequence

Source: R/check_dates_complete.R
check_dates_complete.Rd

This function checks whether a vector of dates is sequential without missing years, months, or days. It can return detailed information about missing units and an overall continuity flag.

Usage

check_dates_complete(
  dates,
  freq = c("year", "month", "day"),
  return_missing = FALSE
)

Arguments

dates

A vector of dates (class Date, POSIXct, or character convertible to Date).

freq

Character vector specifying which levels to check: "year", "month", "day". Default is all three.

return_missing

Logical. If TRUE, returns exact missing years, months, and days.

Value

A list containing:

all_continuous

TRUE if the dates are fully sequential at requested frequency.

year_check

TRUE if years are continuous, FALSE otherwise.

month_issues

Data frame of years with missing months or incorrect days.

day_issues

Data frame of year-month combinations with missing days.

missing

Optional list of exact missing units (years, months, days), only if return_missing = TRUE.

Examples

dates <- seq.Date(as.Date("2020-01-01"), as.Date("2021-12-31"), by = "day")
check_dates_complete(dates)
#> $year_check
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $month_issues
#> # A tibble: 0 × 6
#> # ℹ 6 variables: year <dbl>, n_month <int>, n_day <int>, is_leap <lgl>,
#> #   flag_month <lgl>, flag_day <lgl>
#> 
#> $day_issues
#> # A tibble: 0 × 5
#> # ℹ 5 variables: year <dbl>, month <dbl>, n_day <int>, expected_days <int>,
#> #   flag_day <lgl>
#> 
#> $all_continuous
#> [1] TRUE
#> 

# a missing day is reported
check_dates_complete(dates[-45], return_missing = TRUE)
#> $year_check
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $missing_years
#> integer(0)
#> 
#> $month_issues
#> # A tibble: 0 × 6
#> # ℹ 6 variables: year <dbl>, n_month <int>, n_day <int>, is_leap <lgl>,
#> #   flag_month <lgl>, flag_day <lgl>
#> 
#> $day_issues
#> # A tibble: 1 × 5
#>    year month n_day expected_days flag_day
#>   <dbl> <dbl> <int>         <int> <lgl>   
#> 1  2020     2    28            29 TRUE    
#> 
#> $missing_days
#> $missing_days$`2020-2`
#> [1] "2020-02-14"
#> 
#> 
#> $all_continuous
#> [1] FALSE
#>
